title: Boulderfist clan
wikitext:
A [[tribe]] of [[ogre]]s that live throughout the [[Arathi Highlands]] and currently control parts of [[Stromgarde]].

Their main holds include [[Boulder'gor]] and [[Boulderfist Hall]]. 

Notable Boulderfist Ogres:
*Kor'gresh Coldridge
*Or'Kalar
